forum.title: ECMF02-2AMX6 Pin3 to Connector GND or the System GND?
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome ​@jaehoonlee13, to the community!

in short: you should connect the GND pin to the connector side.

More information can be found in [AN5686](https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an5686-pcb-layout-tips-to-maximize-esd-protection-efficiency-stmicroelectronics.pdf).

Hope that helps?

Regards

/Peter
forum.content_text:
ECMF02-2AMX6 has only one pin for the GND connection, which is unusual.

Where should this pin3 (GND) be connected to? the connector GND or the system GND?

I have common mode choke between the connector GND and the System GND.

Based on the dot notation on the common mode choke, I assumed pin 5 and pin6 should be connected to the connector side so pin3 should be connected to the system GND?
